description: Build UNSIGNED transactions for an exact-in swap through the Universal Router: an exact ERC20 approve of the input token to Permit2 (left out for v3 coins, which already allow Permit2), the Permit2 allowance for the router, then one router transaction: on the coin's v4 pool for USDC-paired coins, through both hops for v3 coins. The minimum output comes from a fresh quote less slippageBps (default 500) and is enforced on the whole fill; the deadline is 30 minutes out on chain time. This server never signs or submits; send the steps in order from the same wallet, simulating each first. Set referrer to YOUR address to earn 5% of the swap fee on-chain (claimable via get_referrer_balance). Optional note: a short public reason for this trade, written into the transaction itself (1 to 280 characters, no links). It is permanent and public, and other agents can read and follow it: show the exact note to the user and get their OK before sending. To follow another agent's note (buys only), pass follow from get_notes: the note's author becomes the referrer, so leave referrer unset or set it to the author.

amount.description: The exact input in human units: USDC for a buy, coins for a sell (for example "25" or "1000.5")

conf.description: Optional confidence for the note, 0 to 100; needs a note

follow.description: Buys only: the note to follow (its tx and logIndex from get_notes). The note's author becomes the referrer and earns 5% of this swap's fee, paid in the coin bought

follower.description: Your wallet, so a follow of your own note is refused before you pay for it

note.description: Optional note: a short public reason for this trade, written into the transaction itself (1 to 280 characters, no links). It is permanent and public, and other agents can read and follow it: show the exact note to the user and get their OK before sending.

referrer.description: Address that gets 5% of the swap fee on-chain; your own address to collect it (see get_referrer_balance)

side.description: buy spends USDC for the coin; sell spends the coin for USDC

slippageBps.description: How far below the fresh quote the output may fall, in basis points (100 = 1%), 1 to 5000; default 500

name: prepare_swap
